sentences.text: Nammi Venkata Kanaka Durga Lakshmi ... vs The State Of

on 15 October, 2020
 The Hon'Ble Smt Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Criminal Petition No.4523 of 2020
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') to quash the proceedings in F.I.R No.492 of 2020 dated 30.09.2020 of Narasannapeta Police Station, Srikakulam registered for the offences punishable under Sections 270 and 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short "I.P.C.").
2.
The petitioners before this Court are accused Nos.1 and 2 in the above said crime.

3. The case of the petitioners' in brief is that on 30.09.2020 while the Police of Narasannapeta Police Station were conducting search of vehicles they found one vehicle i.e. Mahindra XCV 500 Car bearing No.AP 26 BW 4599 coming in high speed and when the inmates of the car tried to escape,
they were caught by the police and some tobacco products were seized.
Basing on the same, the above crime was registered.

4. Heard Sri R.Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor for the State.
5.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that neither of the offences registered under the above sections are applicable to the case on hand as tobacco does not fall under the category of 'food'
and the police have no power to register a case under the above sections except by designated Food Safety Officer, who is competent to investigate and file charge sheet in view of the rules laid down in Sections 41 and 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "FSS Act").
6.

Learned counsel placed reliance on the common order dated 18.12.2019 passed by a Coordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 and batch, wherein it was held that 'tobacco' does not fall within the definition of 'food' as specified under Section 3(i)(j) of the FSS Act.

In view of the same, he urges to quash the proceedings in the above F.I.R.
7.
The above said submission is not disputed by learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

8. In the light of the aforementioned order, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners herein in respect of F.I.R No.492 of 2020 dated 30.09.2020 of Narasannapeta Police Station, Srikakulam District, are quashed.
